text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While talking with Nice Nature and King
Halo
before training gets underway...

text_block_list.name: Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
Um, King! I watched your race the other
day!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Oh, is that so?

text_block_list.name: Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
You were so awesome out there that I
got shivers! You were just like a
king—like the hero of a story!
I hope
someday I can run as well as you!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! It appears my first-rate
running has motivated you! Very well, I
shall grant you the
right to race with
fiery passion!

text_block_list.name: Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
M-me?! N-no way! I couldn't! My class is
having a race soon, but I'd rather just
cheer everyone else
on from the
sidelines...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...I don't know what it is, but I feel a
really strong sense of affinity with you.
It's almost like I've felt
the same way
myself before.

text_block_list.name: Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
Don't be silly! I practically idolize you,
Nature! I'm
like the backup for the
backup—there's no way
we're alike!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Really, now. How can you be so
defeatist after
witnessing my running?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
So be it. In that case, we'll come to your
race and
cheer you on.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Did you just way "we"? Are you
trying to
rope me into this too?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the underclassman's race,
and I've
come to the training track with
Nice Nature.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hey ho. So you're already here, huh.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
And you're late. Hurry up, it's just about
to start.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The moment the gates flip open, racers
clad in
tracksuits burst forth. But it looks
like the runner we're here to support is
getting off to a slow start.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When the racers hit the final stretch,
she's positioned a little behind the pack.
Standard tactics dictate that now would
be the time to
make a final push.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...It'll be tough for her to break into
the
lead. She
might even be lagging farther
back...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Give it your all!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Whoa?! You okay there, King?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: It's up to you to decide who seizes the lead role! Measure up to yourself, not those around you!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Are you going to let the old you hold
you back?
You've trained so hard for
this, haven't you?
Show us the new you!

text_block_list.name: Underclassman
text_block_list.text: King! I...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, she's picking up speed! Where's
all that
strength coming from?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
(Do King's cheers have this much power?
It's not that she's in the stands because
she's in a
supporting role... It's that King
can take the lead role even from the
stands...)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
(So what am I? I'm watching from the
stands, so does that make me a
supporting character? Ahh,
King really is
a bona fide star...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Urged on by King Halo's cheers, the

underclassman suddenly charges through
to the
front of the pack.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: (She's practically shining.)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
What's going on here?! It's like I'm the
only
supporting character here!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Don't give up!

text_block_list.name: Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
...Um, Nature! Thank you so much for
cheering me
on!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hm? No, no, I hardly did anything...
Anyway,
congrats on getting first place.

text_block_list.name: Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
But your voice came through loud and
clear! Hearing someone as cool and
strong as you
cheering for me, I felt
like...

text_block_list.name: Underclassman
text_block_list.text: I felt like I was the star of the race!

text_block_list.name: Underclassman
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I'll be off now! But thank you for

everything!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Well, she got me there.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I, I'm not blushing! I'm just a little hot
from all that
cheering I did... That's all...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...But it feels pretty nice, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It might be subtle, but it looks like
cheering for
that Umamusume has had a
positive influence on
Nice Nature!
